title: Trigger.dev Run Structure
description: Structure documentation for Trigger.dev task run entities

structure.id: string — Unique run identifier with run_ prefix (e.g., run_abc123xyz456)
structure.status: enum — Current run state (QUEUED, EXECUTING, COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY, etc.)
structure.taskIdentifier: string — The task's export identifier (kebab-case by convention)
structure.createdAt: string — ISO 8601 datetime when the run was enqueued
structure.updatedAt: string — ISO 8601 datetime of last status change
structure.startedAt: string|null — ISO 8601 datetime when execution began
structure.finishedAt: string|null — ISO 8601 datetime when execution completed
structure.isTest: boolean — Whether triggered as a test run from the dashboard
structure.payload: any — The JSON payload passed to task.run(payload)
structure.output: any — The return value of task.run() (only on COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY)
structure.tags: array<string> — Up to 10 tags, each max 128 chars

relatedRuns.root: object — The root/top-level run in a chain
relatedRuns.parent: object — The direct parent run (for child tasks)
relatedRuns.children: array — Child runs triggered from within this run

_item.error: object — Error details on failed attempts

notes: payload and output are omitted when using Public API keys
Presigned URLs are provided for payload/output exceeding response size limits
Tag filtering uses exact string match
Pagination uses run IDs (not page numbers) for consistent ordering
